get.description: Read the calling key's current permissions and REST quota, including this request.

post.description:
Search one bounded slice. DuckDuckGo continuations also bind region and time_range.

limit remains an upper bound on results in this operation, capped by search_max_results.
Idempotency-Key replays the same operation for 24 hours; another payload returns 409.
See the versioned docs/SEARCH_API.md for cursor lifecycle, quotas and partial failures.

409.description: Cursor binding/use conflict or idempotency conflict

Retry-After.description: Seconds to retry, only when known

429.description: Shared REST quota or job capacity
Shared REST quota or job capacity

get.description: Read the persistent cookie choice for this project (disabled by default).

put.description:
Apply this choice on subsequent API visits, including search pages and action clicks.

Does not change existing site cookies or immediately act on already open tabs.

200.description: Bounded artifact. Structured JSON follows StructuredSnapshot; legacy JSON, text, HTML and PNG retain their formats.

schema.title: Response 200 Artifact V1 Projects  Slug  Artifacts  Artifact Id  Get

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: Persistent project choice; null disables automatic cookie clicks.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC); null means never

expected_url.title: Expected Url
expected_url.description: Exact final browser URL after challenge resolution; mismatch returns scope_changed. Enables HTTPS-only navigation.

allow_redirects.title: Allow Redirects
allow_redirects.description: Defaults to true independently of expected_url and respect_robots. False rejects a different redirect target before follow.

respect_robots.title: Respect Robots
respect_robots.description: Opt-in bounded robots.txt check; explicit denial blocks acquisition.

http_status.title: Http Status
http_status.description: Observed main-document HTTP status; never inferred from DOM

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: Observed main-document Content-Type, distinct from artifact media_type

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of main-frame commit

region.title: Region
region.description: DuckDuckGo region (country/language); overrides locale's region. Use wt-wt for all regions. Requires the DuckDuckGo engine.

time_range.title: Time Range
time_range.description: DuckDuckGo date filter; any means all dates. A recent result does not guarantee a recent event.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque DuckDuckGo continuation; keep query, engine, locale, region and time_range unchanged.

url.title: Url
url.description: Legacy normalized URL, retained for compatibility

exact_url.title: Exact Url
exact_url.description: Exact target URL after unwrapping the engine redirect

region.title: Region
region.description: Requested region override, or null to use locale

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: null means no usable continuation or unknown end

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: DOM-derived node_id and provenance.xpath; null XPath has an explicit reason
